title: Task due dates shown 3 hours earlier than expected in Process Portal
description: Users are reporting that task due dates in Process Portal are showing 3 hours earlier than the actual deadline. For example a task due at 17:00 Istanbul time is showing as due at 14:00. This is causing users to prioritize tasks unnecessarily.

worklogs.description: Checked BAW application server timezone setting. JVM is running in UTC despite being in Istanbul.
Added -Duser.timezone=Europe/Istanbul to the WAS JVM startup properties.
Restarted BAW server in a low-impact window. Verified due dates now show correctly.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hi, I found the cause. The BAW application server JVM is running in UTC timezone instead of Europe/Istanbul (UTC+3). This causes a 3-hour offset in all displayed timestamps. I need to add a timezone parameter to the server startup configuration and restart the BAW server. This will require a brief restart - I suggest doing it over the lunch break. Would 12:30 today work?

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Restart complete. Task due dates should now display correctly in Istanbul time. Could you check a few tasks and confirm the times look right?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Checked several tasks - they are all showing the correct Istanbul time now. The 3-hour offset is gone. Thanks for the quick fix.

resolutionNote: BAW JVM was running in UTC timezone instead of Europe/Istanbul, causing a 3-hour offset in all displayed timestamps. Added -Duser.timezone=Europe/Istanbul to WAS JVM startup parameters and restarted the server.

csat.comment: Simple fix but really appreciate how quickly it was identified and resolved.
